# Default shape properties

Original XML generated by `tools/canvas_shape_defaults_fixture.py`, using the
project's independently authored OPC control as a shell. No user template is
redistributed. `native.pdf` is the reference application's one-page export, closed without
saving changes to the source. `tools/record_shape_defaults_reference.py` records
its sampled colors, glyph boxes and source/PDF SHA-256 hashes.

Eight page-relative rectangles compare absent declarations, empty `effectLst`,
empty `sp3d`, and both with a one-column `spcCol=914400`. The first four have no
text; the last four contain identical text. The reference application renders all eight backgrounds
identically and keeps text at the same relative position (PDF/raster glyph
quantization differs slightly with absolute position).

This agrees with ECMA-376 Part 1 §§20.1.8.26, 20.1.5.12 and 21.1.2.1.1:
there are no listed effects, no bevel/extrusion/contour, and inter-column spacing
only applies when multiple columns exist. This is not a reference/spec divergence.

Unit tests compare parsed scenes and reject nonempty effects/solids, duplicate
declarations, multiple columns and invalid gap values. Browser tests compare
the reference application's interior/exterior color samples, edit/reopen, preserve retained drawing
XML, and undo to exact package contents. These controls do not establish support
for non-default shape effects, 3D geometry or multiple text columns.
